agents.name: brainstorming
agents.description: Primary read-only agent for exploring requirements and comparing designs before implementation.
agents.notes: Installs ~/.config/opencode/agent/brainstorming.md. Uses the default model and self-contained design guidance.

agents.name: writing
agents.description: Primary agent for natural copy editing and translation with the natural-copy-editing skill and no repo edits.

agents.name: coder
agents.description: Subagent for delegated implementation work using the catalog's coding model.
agents.notes: Installs ~/.config/opencode/agent/coder.md. Its concrete model is rendered from the central catalog role during setup.

agents.name: advisor
agents.description: Read-only technical advisor for architecture, tradeoffs, plans, risks, and code review using the catalog's advisor model.
agents.notes: Installs ~/.config/opencode/agent/advisor.md. Its concrete model is rendered from the central catalog role during setup; edit is denied and bash requires approval.

plugins.name: oh-my-openagent
plugins.description: OMO / oh-my-openagent: opinionated OpenCode workflow layer with agents, hooks, MCPs, planning, and autonomous loops.
plugins.notes: Broad installer that may configure models, providers, hooks, MCPs, and workflow defaults. The setup script prints this command but does not run it. Review telemetry and config behavior before installing.

plugins.name: opencode-mission-control
plugins.description: OpenCode plugin for multi-agent orchestration, tmux/session monitoring, worktree flows, and review/integration helpers.
plugins.notes: Useful when native OpenCode worktrees are not enough and extra orchestration is desired. Keep opt-in because it changes workflow shape.

plugins.name: opencode-gpt-imagegen
plugins.description: OpenCode plugin that exposes GPT image generation from OpenCode.
plugins.notes: Useful for image-generation workflows. Keep opt-in because it requires plugin-specific credentials/configuration.

plugins.name: opencode-handoff
plugins.description: OpenCode plugin that creates focused handoff prompts and opens continuation sessions with editable draft context.
plugins.notes: Adds /handoff and read_session for continuing work in fresh sessions. Requires OpenCode v1.2.15 or later.
